messages:
Alex: Hey folks — final call on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8421. Needs 1 more approval to hit the merge window at 22:00 UTC. Can someone take a quick look? Mainly VPC routing + GPU ENI attach.

infra-bot: CI: plan ✅ apply queued (canary window scheduled). tfsec: pass, terratest: pass.

Maria: I'll review the tf plan now. What's the canary window length? cc @Jin

Jin: I can review in ~30m. Quick Q — does this change NAT GW route priority or add route propagation only?

Alex: It only enables route propagation for gpu-subnet -> peered-vpc and adds tagging on ENIs. No NAT priority changes. Diff snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet_route_table_association" "gpu_rt_assoc" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.gpu.id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.peered.id
}

resource "aws_network_interface" "gpu_eni" {
  subnet_id = aws_subnet.gpu.id
  tags = {
    "service" = "gpu"
    "env" = var.env
  }
}
```

Sam: LGTM on plan, only ask: add tag `infra:gpu` to the subnet too.

Kate: Just left an approval on the PR — go ahead after canary window starts. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks all — merging after canary kicks off (will post merge) :rocket:
